items.source: If included via a RequestDispatcher, the current resource will see the originating request. Its own request URI is exposed as a request attribute.
items.translation: 如果通过 `RequestDispatcher` 包含，当前资源将能看到发起的请求。其自身的请求 URI 作为请求属性暴露出来。

items.source: If included via a RequestDispatcher, the current resource will see the originating context path. Its own context path is exposed as a request attribute.

items.source: If included via a RequestDispatcher, the current resource will see the originating servlet path. Its own servlet path is exposed as a request attribute.

items.source: If included via a RequestDispatcher, the current resource will see the originating query string. Its own query string is exposed as a request attribute.

items.source: Can be used for tools that support substitution with System.getProperty values, like log4j's "${key}" syntax within log file locations.

items.source: Prepends a slash if the path does not already start with a slash, and throws a FileNotFoundException if the path cannot be resolved to a resource (in contrast to ServletContext's getRealPath, which returns null).
items.translation: 如果路径尚未以斜杠开头，则在其前面添加一个斜杠；如果无法将路径解析为资源，则抛出 FileNotFoundException（与 ServletContext 的getRealPath不同，后者返回 null）。

items.source: Returns the session mutex attribute if available; usually, this means that the HttpSessionMutexListener needs to be defined in web.xml. Falls back to the HttpSession itself if no mutex attribute found.

items.source: Clear the Servlet spec's error attributes as HttpServletRequest attributes under the keys defined in the Servlet 2.3 specification: jakarta.servlet.error.status_code, jakarta.servlet.error.exception_type, jakarta.servlet.error.message, jakarta.servlet.error.exception, jakarta.servlet.error.request_uri, jakarta.servlet.error.servlet_name.

items.source: Parse the given string with matrix variables. An example string would look like this "q1=a;q1=b;q2=a,b,c". The resulting map would contain keys "q1" and "q2" with values ["a","b"] and ["a","b","c"] respectively.
items.translation: 解析包含矩阵变量的给定字符串。示例字符串如下："q1=a;q1=b;q2=a,b,c"。生成的映射将包含键 "q1" 和 "q2"，其值分别为 ["a","b"] 和 ["a","b","c"]。

items.source:
Check the given request for a session attribute of the given name.
Returns null if there is no session or if the session has no such attribute.
Does not create a new session if none has existed before!
items.translation: 检查给定名称的会话请求中的会话属性。如果不存在会话或会话没有该属性，则返回 null。如果之前不存在会话，不会创建新会话！

items.source:
Check the given request for a session attribute of the given name.

attribute. Does not create a new session if none has existed before!
items.translation: 检查给定名称的请求中的会话属性。如果不存在会话或会话没有该属性，则抛出异常。如果之前不存在会话，不会创建新会话！

items.source:
Set the session attribute with the given name to the given value.

Does not create a new session if not necessary!
items.translation: 将给定名称的会话属性设置为给定值。如果值为 null，则移除该会话属性（前提是存在会话）。无需时不会创建新会话！

items.source: Try to obtain the parameter value from the parameter name, where the parameter name in the request is of the form logicalName_value = xyz with "_" being the configured delimiter. This deals with parameter values submitted using an HTML form submit button.
items.translation: 尝试从参数名称获取参数值，其中请求中的参数名称形式为 `logicalName_value = xyz`，"_" 为配置的分隔符。此功能处理通过 HTML 表单提交按钮提交的参数值。

items.source: If the value obtained in the previous step has a ".x" or ".y" suffix, remove that. This handles cases where the value was submitted using an HTML form image button. In this case the parameter in the request would actually be of the form logicalName_value.x = 123.
items.translation: 如果上一步获得的值带有 ".x" 或 ".y" 后缀，请将其移除。这处理了使用 HTML 表单图像按钮提交值的场景。在这种情况下，请求中的参数实际上形式为 logicalName_value.x = 123。

items.source: The session mutex is guaranteed to be the same object during the entire lifetime of the session, available under the key defined by the SESSION_MUTEX_ATTRIBUTE constant. It serves as a safe reference to synchronize on for locking on the current session.
items.translation: 会话互斥锁在会话的整个生命周期内保证是同一个对象，可通过由 `SESSION_MUTEX_ATTRIBUTE` 常量定义的键进行访问。它可作为安全引用，用于对当前会话加锁时的同步。

items.source:
In many cases, the HttpSession reference itself is a safe mutex
as well, since it will always be the same object reference for the
same active logical session. However, this is not guaranteed across
different servlet containers; the only 100% safe way is a session mutex.
items.translation: 在许多情况下，HttpSession 引用本身也是一个安全的互斥锁，因为对于同一个活动逻辑会话，它始终指向相同的对象引用。然而，这在不同 Servlet 容器中并不保证；唯一 100% 安全的方式是使用会话互斥锁。
